reviewed_interpretation: The single authoritative I032 execution is valid. All 72 target cases with a causal pre-ready-speech disagreement had an eight-frame strictly post-target ordinary-noise benchmark, giving causal benchmark coverage 1.0. The shipping NS field ns_noise_rms_dbfs, captured on the first causal pre-ready-speech target frame, met both preregistered engineering fidelity bounds against the later same-case ordinary-noise state: median absolute error 1.605659475 dB <= 3 dB and nearest-rank p90 absolute error 3.57573125 dB <= 6 dB. Exact NS/VAD shipping mirrors remained zero-delta. This supports ns_noise_rms_dbfs as a faithful target-side causal noise-scale observable in the public-development diagnostic population. It does not select a normalization mapping, reference source, component, threshold or shipping change. Descriptively, frozen donor-versus-causal-target noise-scale mismatch co-varies with frozen donor gap transfer error: Spearman rho is 0.3256479516, and median gap error rises monotonically from 0.03831 in the lowest mismatch quartile to 0.14625 in the highest. However absolute proxy bias is condition-dependent: global median signed error is +0.578 dB, while living and kitchen are near +2 dB and office is near zero; kitchen p90 absolute error is 6.0786 dB. Therefore the next high-information step should test offset-invariant relative noise-state change alignment between shipping NS and the post-NS/VAD observation domain before any absolute normalization or source patch is designed.

fidelity_review.population: target cases with at least one causal pre-ready-speech target and eight strictly post-target ordinary-noise reference frames

descriptive_transfer_review.authority: descriptive only; cannot select a mapping or candidate

root_cause_review.note: I032 supports observability, not an absolute-value normalization law. Condition-dependent bias makes an offset-invariant relative-state differential the next appropriate test.

proposed_followup_hypothesis.rationale: Use entirely fresh public-development target seeds and the unchanged shipping NS/VAD path. Do not use donor cases or evaluate a normalization/source candidate. For each target case with a first pre-ready-speech disagreement and at least one prior ordinary-noise non-disagreement reference, use the last prior reference as a causal anchor. Capture shipping NS ns_noise_rms_dbfs and post-NS frame RMS dBFS at the anchor and at the causal target. Retrospectively benchmark the local observation-domain change using the median post-NS RMS dBFS over the first eight strictly post-target ordinary-noise non-disagreement frames. Compare the causal NS delta [target ns_noise_rms_dbfs - anchor ns_noise_rms_dbfs] with the future local-domain delta [later median post-NS RMS dBFS - anchor post-NS RMS dBFS]. This removes per-domain absolute offset and tests whether the shipping NS state can drive a parameter-free relative VAD-noise-state alignment. Preregister median absolute delta error <=3 dB and nearest-rank p90 <=6 dB, plus sufficient causal-anchor coverage. Also report the existing VAD noise-state error descriptively if exposed, but do not select a refresh rule.
required_gates: fresh target seeds disjoint from I025-I032
first pre-ready-speech target and last prior ordinary-noise anchor are both causal
post-target eight-frame benchmark is retrospective only
NS delta and local-domain delta use the same causal anchor
median absolute delta error and nearest-rank p90 reported
no donor selection, normalization mapping, threshold search or source candidate evaluated

verification_limits: I032 is development-only and does not establish product acoustic behavior.
Global fidelity passed the preregistered engineering bounds, but per-domain signed bias and tails are heterogeneous; the global PASS must not be converted into an absolute normalization law.
The donor mismatch correlation and quartiles are descriptive only and cannot select a mapping, donor, component or candidate.
The later eight-frame reference is retrospective evidence only and is not available causally at the target frame.

No normalization mapping, reference-source candidate, source patch, component counterfactual, threshold, tracker change, validation-grade, blind, HIL, product-certification or release authority was consumed.
